text:
```yaml
name: Test Analysis

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  download-artifacts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Download JUnit XML artifacts from Tests workflow
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: tests-results
          path: ./tests-results

  publish-test-results:
    needs: download-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          profile: minimal
          toolchain: stable
          override: true
      
      - name: Publish unit test results
        uses: dorny/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          check-name: "Rust Unit Tests"
          files: |
            ./tests-results/*.xml
```
